title: Introducing Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 (Capsid Modeling and 24-hr Binder Benchmark)
plm_baselines: OpenFold3-preview2 and ESMFold2 used as orchestrated folding engines (no standalone baseline table)
code_and_data_released: No capsid target list, per-target RMSDs, code, prompts, or binder metric definition released in the blog post (defers to System Card).

methods.datasets: 34 natural and engineered viral capsids (including AAV2 PDB:1LP3); unspecified 24-hour de novo binder design benchmark.
methods.evaluation_protocol: Mythos 5.2 writes code running OpenFold3-preview2 and ESMFold2 on overlapping chain subsets and merges predictions using known capsid symmetries ('big bang' initialization referenced in prompt, Footnote 3). Counted accurate if either OpenFold3-preview2 OR ESMFold2 achieves Ca RMSD < 3 A.
methods.controls_included: None reported in the release post.
methods.compute_and_tools: NVIDIA H200 GPU running OpenFold3-preview2 (~58 min on AAV2) and ESMFold2 (~7 min on AAV2); GPT-6 Astra and Gemini 4 Carbon omitted ('—') on the binder table.
methods.metrics: Capsid count within 3 A Ca RMSD (best of two folding models); undefined numeric score (85.1) for 24-hr binder design.

key_results.benchmark: 34 natural and engineered capsids (incl. AAV2 PDB:1LP3)
key_results.metric: Count with Ca RMSD < 3 A (OpenFold3-preview2 or ESMFold2)
key_results.llm_model: Claude Mythos 5.2 writing symmetry-merging wrapper around OpenFold3-preview2 / ESMFold2
key_results.llm_score: 28/34 capsids < 3 A (AAV2: 1.2 A OpenFold3-preview2, 1.4 A ESMFold2)
key_results.notes: Folding is performed by OpenFold3-preview2 and ESMFold2 with best-of-two selection, known symmetries, and 'big bang' initialization hinted in prompt; no baseline or capsid list published.

key_results.baseline_model: GPT-6 Astra / Gemini 4 Carbon / specialized pipelines
key_results.notes: No targets, metric definition, or external baselines appear in this release post.

temporal_cutoff.evidence: AAV2 (PDB:1LP3) is a classic public structure and no temporal holdout is stated for the 34 capsids or binder targets.

homology_overlap.evidence: No sequence or structural split against Claude, OpenFold3-preview2, or ESMFold2 training data.

cross_modal_literature_recall.evidence: Known capsid symmetries were leveraged and Footnote 3 explicitly notes 'big bang' initialization was referenced in the prompt.

preprocessing_artifacts.evidence: Best-of-two selection across OpenFold3-preview2 and ESMFold2 defines capsid success; binder score 85.1 lacks metric units or target list.

downstream_oracle_filtering.evidence: Structure prediction is executed entirely by OpenFold3-preview2 and ESMFold2 rather than intrinsic LLM folding.

compute_and_tool_asymmetry.evidence: Runs OpenFold3-preview2 and ESMFold2 on H200 GPUs; competitor rows are blank.

baseline_fairness.evidence: No comparison against existing symmetry-folding tools (SymProFold, CombFold, FoldaVirus) cited in Footnote 3.

data_and_wetlab_transparency.evidence: No target list, code, prompts, wet-lab data, or per-capsid RMSD table released in the post.

takeaway: Anthropic's release post shows Claude Mythos 5.2 orchestrating OpenFold3-preview2 and ESMFold2 via symmetry-aware scripts to model 28/34 capsids within 3 A, alongside an undocumented 85.1 binder benchmark score. Without target lists, baselines, or metric definitions, neither claim is independently verifiable as a controlled LLM-vs-pLM comparison.
